name: RemoveLabels
label: Remove Labels
description: Send the ticked labels of a label map to the background. While a Label Map visualization of the same data is open, the labels hidden there are the ones ticked here, and ticking a label here hides it there, so the visualization shows what will be kept.

parameters.name: labels
parameters.label: Labels to Remove
parameters.description: Label values to send to the background, separated by commas, with runs written as first-last: "3, 5, 10-14".

parameters.name: renumber
parameters.label: Renumber Remaining Labels
parameters.description: Number the labels that remain 1, 2, 3... in ascending order of their old values. Off, they keep their values so names and colors in a Label Map visualization still line up.
